ECB contract-probe ReadTimeout trio (new shape): first occurrence, cycle 838 (2026-10-03T00:01:22Z). auth:listing, errors:missing_artefact, and references:contentconstraint all read skipped with a 30s ReadTimeout; the other nine ECB contract assertions and all five basic checks stayed ok/healthy, so endpoint status was unaffected (healthy throughout). This is the designed unobservable-evidence path (monitor/contracts.py _skip_reason): a transport timeout maps to skipped, never broken, and does not appear in /api/contracts changes (which only diffs observed, not verdict). See the 2026-10-03T00:44Z report entry. Live recheck at 00:44Z of the same three ECB URLs returned quickly (1.1s, 1.1s, 0.66s), consistent with transient slowness rather than a standing problem. Watch for a second occurrence; escalate only if it recurs or starts affecting the basic checks.
